body.label: Effect
body.html: Suffer -1 Defense until your next turn. Choose one ally within 5 units; it gains +1 die on its next Action or Reaction.

surges.html: When this Rite's next Echo resolves, it may affect one additional eligible target.
If the Rite targets a Possessed creature, you may remove Possessed after an Echo resolves.

rider.title: OFFERING RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: A creature within 5 units suffers a Wound. Echo: Choose one ally within 5 units; it may remove Dazed, Concussed, or Shocked.
